title: Telos

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content:
- Long-term goals often feel disconnected from daily work.
- They almost seemed impossible to get to where I wanted to be from where I am right now.
- When I explored productivity apps to help me with this, most of them needed me to add separate tasks.
- I wanted a system that could bridge the gap between vision and execution.

slides.title: Why It Mattered
slides.content:
- Long-term goals often feel disconnected from daily work.
- They almost seemed impossible to get to where I wanted to be from where I am right now.
- When I explored productivity apps to help me with this, most of them needed me to add separate tasks.
- I wanted a system that could bridge the gap between vision and execution.

slides.title: My Approach
slides.content:
Rather than starting with features, I began by thinking about how people naturally reflect on their lives.

- I designed the experience around a **conversation** instead of forms.
- I created a first version with Opencode to rapidly prototype different core flows.
- Every iteration was driven by my own daily use.
- My goal was to learn one new concept each time while continuously refining the experience.

slides.title: Biggest Challenge
slides.content:
Implementing the UI wasn't that difficult.

The real challenge was designing the core experience:
- Helping users reflect on themselves.
- Uncover their core beliefs.
- Define meaningful long-term goals.

I explored multiple approaches to make this process feel as natural and frictionless as possible.

This eventually became my longest AI-assisted project.

slides.title: Outcome
slides.content:
- Built a functional AI planning system for personal use.
- Created an end-to-end workflow from vision to daily execution.
- Validated conversational planning as a more engaging alternative to traditional planners.
- Established a strong foundation for future iterations.
- Shared it with friends and colleagues — a few of them now use it on a daily basis.

slides.title: Skills Unlocked
slides.content:
- **Human-AI Interaction** — designing natural conversational flows
- **Prompt Engineering** — structuring prompts for meaningful reflection
- **Supabase backend integration** — data modeling and real-time sync
- **Rapid Prototyping** — iterating fast with Opencode
- **AI Product Design** — bridging user needs with model capabilities
